details:
We have developed a complex website model, which introduces an interactive Earth map with different parameters (temperature, names, etc). When clicking on any place on this map, our website states the similarity of this place with the appropriate selected place on the Mars and the Moon. Also, we have added already investigated similar places with regular and satellite photos on the Earth, the Mars, the Moon, reasoning it with temperature, altitude, radioactivity, magnetic field, UV index, minerals (and their chemical composition), etc, and mission information is available to download as a brief in pdf format.

If there is a need to find an Earth analog to a location by goal, it can be done easily by selecting a target body, exact engineering goal, and required conditions, which significantly lightens the process of selecting of the right location and collects all important data together.

We were investigated such engineering and scientific parameters and approaches, interpretted obtained results and made assumptions, because of combinig of received sources with our knowledge as Chemical Engineering students (studied physics and chemistry of objects, surfaces, engineering goal processes such as water extraction or bases construction).

Beyond open source information (maps, news, resources of NASA and other Space Agencies), we have used AI mostly for giving a visuality of our ideas (we were uploaded several prompts, our suggestions about what we were expected to see on our website, links with some used sources, adjusting the results by verifying data on the website and checking its code), Python knowledges.

We think our integrated databases and vizualised ideas can help in focusing on explorations and practical parts, reducing time spent on data collection and analysis. Moreover, we wanted to show that in today's reality it is possible to visualize any ideas with the help of AI and modify obtained results, checking the code and completing the Machine Learning process simultaneously.
